text:
Maya: quick note from QA on the Dashboard table: when you shift+select rows that scroll offscreen, screen readers don't announce the selection count. saw this in Jobs and Runs tables.

Ethan: yep, virtualization culprits. visual selection is fine but SR has no context.

Priya: can we add an aria-live summary plus a small persistent counter in the header? that should help keyboard + SR users.

Ethan: implementation plan: shared offscreen live region (polite, aria-atomic=true) updated with a debounce (200ms). also expose aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex on visible rows.

Maya: copy for the live region should be short: "{count} rows selected". toast copy: "{count} rows selected  Apply" for mouse users. keep i18n keys small.

Priya: visual side: prefer minimal UI. persistent counter left of filters, and only show a temporary toast when selection > 25. avoids clutter.

Ethan: will add Table props: announceOnRangeSelect (default true), selectionAnnouncement (string | fn), liveDebounceMs. will add a Storybook story showing shift-select across virtualization.

design-bot: uploaded mock: https://redwood-internal.s3/mockups/virtualized-select.png

Maya: thanks. action items: Ethan -> PR + story; Priya -> approve copy; Maya -> add changelog entry.

Ethan: starting PR now, ETA tomorrow morning.

Priya: will draft toast variants.

Maya: closing loop. :white_check_mark:
